title: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.22878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. translated_title: 面向基于流的VLA策略的结果平衡PPO与策略诱导流整流方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）通过在环境交互中优化期望任务回报，能够对基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行后训练。然而，这种优化带来两个挑战：策略更新可能改变用于随机转移的分数近似所依赖的速度场几何结构；稀疏的多任务轨迹采样会导致不同任务之间以及不同优势符号之间的学习信号不均衡。我们提出了一个将结果平衡近端策略优化（PPO）与策略诱导流整流相结合的强化学习框架。结果平衡PPO利用任务成功率估计对正优势进行重新加权，并在保持符号不变的前提下对正负优势进行重新缩放。策略诱导整流则周期性地将线性桥流拟合到由当前策略生成的ODE端点对上，从而刷新后续随机优化中所使用的表示。我们评估了该框架……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种结合结果平衡PPO（利用任务成功率重加权并重缩放优势）与策略诱导流整流（周期性刷新速度场表示）的强化学习框架，以解决基于流的VLA策略后训练中速度场几何变化和多任务学习信号不均衡两大难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced PPO (reweighting and rescaling advantages via task success-rate estimates) with policy-induced flow rectification (periodically refreshing the velocity-field representation), addressing velocity-field geometry shifts and uneven multi-task learning signals in post-training flow-based VLA policies.
